data.name: Adam Warlock
data.summary: The genetically-engineered Adam Warlock wields mighty Quantum Magic, allowing him to connect and heal souls with a gentle touch. When the time comes for his allies to unite, Warlock emerges as the unwavering epicenter of cosmic justice!
data.playstyle: Play close enough to maintain line of sight, cycling Quantum Magic and Karmic Revival to stabilize fights. Hold defensive resources for the enemy engage and rotate early when susceptible to dives and flanking if his flying gauge is low.
weaknesses: Susceptible to dives and flanking if his flying gauge is low.
Regenerative Cocoon has a very long cooldown of 105 seconds.
Cosmic Cluster shares ammo with Quantum Magic.

abilities.name: Quantum Magic
abilities.description: Launch quantum energy to deal damage

technicalDetails.label: Damage Falloff
technicalDetails.value: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 60% at 40m

abilities.name: Karmic Revival
abilities.description: Take to the skies, entering a flying state and swiftly surge forward

abilities.name: Karmic Revival
abilities.description: Awaken the karma of allies to revive them. Allies revived have lower health but enjoy a brief period of Invincibility

technicalDetails.label: Casting
technicalDetails.value: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: Revive allies within range, centered on Adam. Continuously monitor for fallen allies within this range; if they enter the area, they can be revived at the casting location

technicalDetails.label: Health Upon Revival
technicalDetails.value: Allies revived will be blessed with Bonus Health equal to 70% of their Maximum Health with a 5s duration. Bonus Health falloff begins at 5s, decreasing to 0 in 2s.

abilities.name: Soul Bond
abilities.description: Forge a soul bond with allies, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect 1
technicalDetails.value: Adam Warlock will share a portion of the damage sustained by linked allies. If Adam Warlock sustains damage that would KO him due to the link, then the link will be broken, and he will retain 1 Health. The link will also break once enough damage is sustained, if Adam Warlock or the linked ally leave the link's range, or after a certain length of time has passed

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect 2
technicalDetails.value: Adam can hover and attack during the ability's duration

abilities.name: Avatar Life Stream
abilities.description: Target an ally for a bouncing stream of healing energy, which also heals himself upon casting; self-targets if no ally is selected

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: Bouncing target does not include Adam Warlock

technicalDetails.label: Cooldown
technicalDetails.value: 2 charges, with each charge taking 6s to recharge; when a critical hit lands on an enemy, reduce the cooldown time of Avatar Life Stream by 1s.

abilities.name: Cosmic Cluster
abilities.description: Gather quantum energy into a cluster and then swiftly launch it at the enemy

technicalDetails.label: Casting
technicalDetails.value: Charged release, with multiple delayed projectiles

technicalDetails.label: Fire Rate
technicalDetails.value: The firing interval for a single charged shot is 0.3s, while the interval for multiple shots is 0.07s

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: Cosmic Cluster shares ammo with Quantum Magic, each hit reduces the cooldown of Avatar Life Stream by 0.6s.

abilities.name: Regenerative Cocoon
abilities.description: Once his body perishes, Adam Warlock can freely move as a soul and reforge his body at a chosen spot

abilities.name: HEAVENLY HARMONY
abilities.description: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

abilities.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
abilities.description: Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

abilities.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
abilities.description: Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

technicalDetails.label: Healing To Allies Hit By Cosmic Cluster

buildProfileRationale.reason: Adam Warlock was scored from Fandom overview text, listed strengths/weaknesses, ability descriptions, and 66 technical detail entries. Strategist role weighting sets the baseline, then descriptions adjust Utility, Damage, Sustain, Mobility, and Ultimate independently. 3 ultimate-labeled ability entryies and 1 passive entry influenced the final profile.

data.overview: Adam Warlock was created to be the perfect specimen. Able to manipulate powerful cosmic forces, he represents the full potential of what we could one day become. Until then, he stands alone as a shining golden beacon of all that is good within us. When the Timestream Entanglement struck, Adam Warlock reflexively shielded himself in a protective cocoon. When he emerged, his cosmic senses identified Knull's impending threat. Traveling to Klyntar, Adam encountered the Guardians of the Galaxy and discovered a power even greater than Knull's, ready to incinerate the planet—and countless others.

strategyGuide.sourceTitle: Adam Warlock strategy on Marvel Rivals Wiki
strategyGuide.summary: Adam Warlock plays as a fight stabilizer.
paragraphs: Adam Warlock lives and dies by his team. His abilities require his allies to be grouped up near him in order to maximize his value. As Adam, you should take careful note of where your allies are positioned at all times, and try to coordinate with them to not split off too far from you so that your abilities can gain the maximum value.

situations.label: Bait cooldowns
situations.description: Show pressure, make enemies spend mobility, shields, crowd control, or sustain, then reset before recommitting.

situations.label: Backline pressure
situations.description: Look for supports, snipers, or ranged damage dealers who are distracted or separated from their frontline.

situations.label: Peel and stabilize
situations.description: Turn back toward threatened allies when enemy divers commit and trade your utility for their engage tools.

situations.label: Finish windows
situations.description: Commit damage after enemies lose escape options, defensive cooldowns, or healing resources.

situations.label: Disengage routes
situations.description: Keep one movement or defensive option available so you can leave after drawing focus.

data.name: Angela
data.summary: As the Hand of Heven, the warrior called Angela embodies unwavering courage and determination. Able to manipulate Ichors into various weapons and unfurl her wings to soar across the battlefield, she is ready to deliver divine judgment upon her foes!
data.playstyle: Lead space with SHIELDED STANCE, then hold enemy attention with Spear of Ichors. Take short, deliberate trades and avoid overcommitting when less health compared to other Vanguards.
weaknesses: Less health compared to other Vanguards.
Has high skill ceiling to manage her resources and switch between her flying and ground stances...
Spears of Ichor has a low attack speed and requires a more pinpoint accuracy.

abilities.name: Spear of Ichors
abilities.description: Lunge forward with your spear, dealing damage that increases with Attack Charge. At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies and cause 20 extra damage.

abilities.name: Axes Of Ichors
abilities.description: Alternate powerful strikes forward with twin axes, dealing increased damage as Attack Charge grows. The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash

technicalDetails.label: Damage
technicalDetails.value: First three strikes: 30; the forth strike: 50.

technicalDetails.label: Attack Interval
technicalDetails.value: First three strikes: 0.4s per hit; the forth strike: 0.6s per hit.

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash.

abilities.name: SHIELDED STANCE
abilities.description: Transform Ichors into a shield, gaining Attack Charge when absorbing damage

abilities.name: Seraphic Soar
abilities.description: Glide freely through the air. Continuous flight builds Attack Charge

technicalDetails.label: Glide Activation Condition
technicalDetails.value: Maintain the forward speed faster than 5m/s for 1s

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.description: Dive downward, switch to twin axes and infuse the ground with Ichors to create a Divine Judgement Zone upon impact. Within the zone, gain enhanced Speed and attacks grant Bonus Health to self and nearby allies

technicalDetails.label: Damage Over Time Spell Field Range
technicalDetails.value: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 8m and a height of 2m.

technicalDetails.label: Bonus Health
technicalDetails.value: Within the Divine Judgement zone, Angela’s each Axes of Ichors hit grants 50 Bonus Health to herself and 25 Bonus Health to allies within the area.

abilities.name: Wingblade Ascent
abilities.description: Take to the skies, switching back to Spear of Ichors

abilities.name: Assassin's Charge
abilities.description: Enter an accelerated dash state, enemies struck head-on are carried through the air for a short distance

technicalDetails.label: Energy Required To Activate The Ability
Passive Energy Gained During The Dash
Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: Every enemy pierced grants Angela with a 50/s passive energy recovery.

abilities.name: Heven's Retribution
abilities.description: Wrap your spear in ribbons and hurl it with force. Upon impact, the ribbons bind nearby enemies. Angela can leap to the spear's location, damaging surrounding enemies and creating a Divine Judgement Zone

technicalDetails.label: Special Effect
technicalDetails.value: Mobility abilities of enemies bound by the ribbons will be disabled. Enemies within a certain distance around the spear will be slowed.

abilities.name: Celestial Command
abilities.description: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

abilities.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
abilities.description: Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

technicalDetails.label: Bonus Health
technicalDetails.value: Gain 75 Bonus Health per target hit, up to 200

abilities.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
abilities.description: Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while. Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

data.overview: Long ago, Aldrif, the infant daughter of Odin, was stolen and raised amongst the Angels of the Tenth Realm. She rose through their ranks to become the realm's most feared and respected warrior — Angela, the Hand of Heven. When Hela kidnapped Angela's baby sister, Laussa, Angela prepared to give chase. But all of Heven was swept into a collapsing universe where gods and demons were locked in eternal combat. Angela eventually found her way back home, tracking Laussa and Hela to the Eighth City in the newly-formed Heart of Heaven.

strategyGuide.summary: Angela plays as a space-maker who forces enemy cooldowns and attention and stabilizes teammates through burst pressure. Key tools: Spear of Ichors, Axes of Ichors, Heven's Retribution.
paragraphs: Angela's main edge is a versatile fighter who can switch between two stances, allowing her to either serve as a solid.... Use Spear of Ichors and Axes of Ichors to take space, force attention, and make enemies spend important cooldowns before your team fully commits.
Angela is strongest when you pressure a valuable angle, bait defensive tools, then leave before the enemy can punish you. Respect this limitation: less health compared to other vanguards.
Use Heven's Retribution to start a decisive push, survive the enemy counter-engage, or turn a messy fight into space your team can actually occupy.
